current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
(a) An Airplane Flight Manual shall be furnished with each airplane, having a maximum certificated weight of more than 6,000 pounds. The portions of this document listed below shall be verified and approved by the Administrator, and Shall be segregated, identified, and clearly distinguished from portions not So approved. Additional items of information having a direct and important bearing on safe operdtion may be required by the Administrator when unusual design, operating, or handling characteristics so warrant.
(b) For airplanes having a maximum certificated weight of 6,000 pounds or less an Airplane Flight Manual is not required; instead, the information prescribed in this part for inclusion in the Airplane Flight Manual shall be made available to the operator by the manufacturer in the form of clearly stated placards, markings, or manuals.
